title: The Candle and the Moth
summary: Watching a moth circle his oil lamp, Nasruddin blew out the flame and opened the window:...
keywords: the candle and the moth - nasruddin
full_text:
Watching a moth circle his oil lamp, Nasruddin blew out the flame and opened the window:

"Fly out into the moonlit garden, little brother! It is better to fly freely under the cool light of the moon than to burn your wings for a fleeting flicker of fire."
moral: Do not be consumed by dazzling fires that you do not understand.
